title: Setup notification preferences: draw quiet hours (免打扰) as a time-range control instead of a JSON box (#30208 row 6 step 3)
body:
domain:server#5 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5o8PE7ZtVjcor51wBZ

Filing gate: ② owed by #30208 row 6, step 3 of the recorded steps (6670396132, ruling E on decision #30527, the maintainer's 「同意」 2026-11-05T21:42Z): "Quiet-hours time-range control: its own ui card, not waiting on this ruling". It was not cut until now. ⛔ Not a claim.
Reader: the `domain:ui` seat that owns the Setup record form widgets (`ui/packages/**` field renderers).
Dedupe (open AND closed): `quiet hours`, `免打扰`, `quiet_hours control` → only #30208 and its row-6 children #31062 / #31004 (topic and channel only).
reach: every administrator or user who sets 免打扰 on a notification preference in Setup.
class: a · type: Enhancement
Grade: p3, as its parent #30208.

## 维护者速读

通知偏好的「免打扰」现在是一个 JSON 输入框，要手写 `{ "tz": "Europe/Berlin", "start": "22:00", "end": "07:00" }`。应当换成一个时间段控件：时区选择 + 开始/结束时间，可跨午夜。存储格式不变。

## What to do

- `sys_notification_preference.quiet_hours` (`packages/services/service-messaging/src/objects/notification-preference.object.ts`, `Field.json`) stores `{ tz?, start: 'HH:MM', end: 'HH:MM' }`, where an absent tz means UTC and the window may run past midnight. Draw it as a time-zone picker plus two time inputs. Write exactly that shape, and read an existing value back into the control. An unreadable stored value shows as-is with a note and is never silently rewritten.
- If the ui needs the field to declare a widget hint, as the topic and channel fields do since #31004, that is a small server half. Name it here and the server lane cuts it. Otherwise this is ui-only.
- Pins: an empty value writes nothing, a 22:00 to 07:00 window round-trips, and a stored value without tz reads as UTC.

Refs #30208
